topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: Many mutual funds offer multiple share classes that all invest in the same underlying securities but that each have different sales loads and operating expenses.
answer: A mutual fund may offer different share classes that invest in the same underlying securities but charge different sales loads and operating expenses. Because those costs differ, owning a different class of the same fund may result in different investment returns. Check the prospectus fee table for the costs of each class, and make sure you are reviewing information for the share class you own or are considering. Shareholder reports are prepared separately for each class.
